about: Morsveld の人物の絵の一覧。tags は Stable Diffusion のポジティブプロンプトに入れる、その人の特徴だけ（画風・品質・構図は持ち主の側で足す）。tools/portraits.mjs で docs/art/portraits.md を作る

size.framing: 縦長・胸から上・顔が上から 1/3 あたり

heroAge.old: old man / old woman, wrinkles, grey hair, 65 years old

beasts.dog: dog ears, floppy ears, dog tail
beasts.bear: bear ears, round ears, bear tail
beasts.bird: head wings, feathered ears, bird tail
beasts.rat: mouse ears, round ears, mouse tail

portraits.name: ディル
portraits.tags: 1boy, young man, 24 years old, brown hair, messy hair, narrow eyes, sly smirk, slim, worn vest, rolled-up sleeves, daggers on belt, holding an old book
portraits.memo: 本好きでずる賢い港町の青年。にやりと何か企んでいる顔

portraits.name: カイデル
portraits.tags: 1boy, man, 30 years old, dark brown hair, spiky hair, headband, big grin, scar on face, bandages, stubble, muscular, broad shoulders, red leather armor, torn clothes, fists
portraits.memo: 傷だらけの凄腕傭兵。お気楽で、迷ったら殴る。屈託のない笑い

portraits.name: ノラミ（ノラ）
portraits.tags: 1girl, dog girl, dog ears, floppy ears, dog tail, 18 years old, brown hair, messy hair, wild hair, brown eyes, round eyes, big grin, fang, leather hunter clothes, dirt on face, energetic
portraits.memo: 森の犬の獣人。明るい愛すべきあほ。歯を見せて笑う

portraits.name: シェイラ
portraits.tags: 1girl, princess, 18 years old, long hair, blonde hair, half-closed eyes, sleepy eyes, expressionless, petite, slim, blue hooded cloak, gem pendant, holding a book
portraits.memo: 第七王子の姫。大人しそうで実はお転婆。眠たげな目で「うん、」

portraits.name: ルイ
portraits.tags: 1girl, child, 9 years old, small child, blue hair, short hair, bob cut, half-closed eyes, expressionless, white ancient robe, simple clothes
portraits.memo: 遺跡で眠っていた無口な女の子。表情が動かない。子どもらしく

portraits.name: ゼリナ
portraits.tags: 1girl, 23 years old, red hair, ponytail, freckles, closed eyes, big grin, kerchief, merchant vest, coin pouch, confident
portraits.memo: 関西言葉の商人の娘。物怖じしない、金が大好き。にかっと笑う

portraits.name: エルネア
portraits.tags: 1girl, elf, pointy ears, 19 years old, short, plump, brown hair, short hair, messy bob cut, round eyes, worried eyebrows, open mouth, blush, work apron, soot on face, holding a crystal ore
portraits.memo: エルフの鉱石おたくの技師。容姿に自信がなく、おどおど。「〜っす」

portraits.name: ナタリア
portraits.tags: 1girl, 24 years old, black hair, single braid, half-closed eyes, grin, blush, drunk, martial artist, dark blue martial arts uniform, holding a sake bottle
portraits.memo: 王国十指の格闘家。酒好きで、ほろ酔いの笑い。実力は本物

portraits.name: ヴァレオン
portraits.tags: 1boy, old man, king, 58 years old, grey hair, silver hair, wild hair, grey beard, amber eyes, fierce grin, scar, muscular, crown, red royal cape, plate armor, greatsword
portraits.memo: レオネストの国王。好戦家で若返った鋼の体。獰猛に笑う

portraits.name: ライオス
portraits.tags: 1boy, prince, 32 years old, dark blonde hair, long hair, low ponytail, blue eyes, gentle smile, laughing, tall, muscular, blue plate armor, crest
portraits.memo: 第一王子。誠実で包容力のある完璧超人。よく高笑いする

portraits.name: セリオス
portraits.tags: 1boy, prince, 30 years old, silver hair, long hair, handsome, half-closed eyes, aloof, slender, dark grey coat, gem brooch, paint stains
portraits.memo: 第二王子。銀髪の天才肌、浮世離れした芸術家。遠くを見る顔

portraits.name: ファリナ
portraits.tags: 1girl, princess, 28 years old, black hair, long hair, low ponytail, glasses, cold eyes, narrow eyes, serious expression, dark blue noble dress, chain necklace
portraits.memo: 第三王子（女）。冷静な完璧主義者。笑わない。冷たい視線

portraits.name: グレオル
portraits.tags: 1boy, prince, 27 years old, brown hair, short hair, tan skin, scar on cheek, frown, stern, muscular, dull worn armor, sword
portraits.memo: 第四王子。生真面目で口下手な武人。むすっと真っすぐ

portraits.name: ネイラス
portraits.tags: 1boy, prince, 24 years old, black hair, messy hair, androgynous, pale skin, half-closed eyes, eye bags, shy, worried eyebrows, white lab coat
portraits.memo: 第五王子。儚く中性的な引きこもりの研究者。目を合わせない

portraits.name: ティリア
portraits.tags: 1girl, princess, 23 years old, light brown hair, soft hair, braid, closed eyes, gentle smile, freckles, kerchief, modest green dress, apron, dirt on cheek
portraits.memo: 第六王子（女）。現場主義でにこやかな愛され姫。少し天然

portraits.name: 第六騎士団の団長
portraits.tags: 1boy, knight captain, 33 years old, black hair, slicked back hair, narrow eyes, expressionless, slim, black plate armor, crest, sword
portraits.memo: 王国最強の剣。寡黙で何を考えているか分からない

portraits.name: アンジェリカ
portraits.tags: 1girl, woman, 31 years old, dirty blonde hair, hair bun, military cap, sharp eyes, angry, shouting, open mouth, blue military uniform, armor, holding a pistol
portraits.memo: 王国軍の女隊長。敵だが抜けていて人がいい。おばさん呼ばわりに怒る

portraits.name: 寡黙な隊長
portraits.tags: 1boy, man, 28 years old, dark brown hair, short hair, stubble, calm, stoic, blue military uniform, armor, spear, broad shoulders
portraits.memo: アンジェリカと組む隊長。寡黙で任務に忠実

portraits.name: 博士
portraits.tags: 1boy, old man, 61 years old, white hair, receding hairline, monocle, wrinkles, round eyes, creepy smile, white lab coat, keys
portraits.memo: 使徒を研究する学者。倫理を気にしない。にこにこして不気味

portraits.name: ヘル爺
portraits.tags: 1boy, old man, 62 years old, white hair, wild hair, white beard, round eyes, big grin, explorer hat, brown coat, dirt, energetic
portraits.memo: 元気な考古学者の爺さん。遺跡が生きがい

portraits.name: ユリナ
portraits.tags: 1girl, 27 years old, red hair, short hair, closed eyes, smirk, slim, dark leather swordsman outfit, sword
portraits.memo: 直轄特殊部隊の剣士。糸目で飄々と笑う、戦うと冷徹

portraits.name: フェリダ
portraits.tags: 1girl, 26 years old, blonde hair, ponytail, sharp eyes, confident smirk, white plate armor, crest, lance
portraits.memo: 王国十指《雷突の乙女》。王国一の槍使い

portraits.name: シグ
portraits.tags: 1boy, man, 38 years old, bald, brown beard, scar, stern, angry eyebrows, very muscular, large build, heavy dark plate armor, battle axe
portraits.memo: 王国十指《戦場の鉄塊》。王国最強の盾

portraits.name: ライーシャ
portraits.tags: 1girl, 28 years old, dark grey hair, long hair, half-closed eyes, eye bags, glaring, bored expression, black cloak, sword
portraits.memo: 王国十指の天才剣士。目つきが悪く、いつも気だるそう

portraits.name: ゾルク
portraits.tags: 1boy, man, 43 years old, grey hair, receding hairline, eyepatch, scar, stubble, sharp eyes, smirk, wide-brimmed hat, dark long coat, chain, sword
portraits.memo: 王国十指《首狩りゾルク》。非公認の賞金稼ぎ

portraits.name: 大槌の姉さん
portraits.tags: 1girl, woman, 34 years old, blonde hair, hair bun, closed eyes, big grin, blush, muscular, armor, large war hammer
portraits.memo: めちゃくちゃ強い、婚期を逃したお姉さん。豪快に笑う

portraits.name: 「ボク」の娘
portraits.tags: 1girl, tomboy, 17 years old, brown hair, short hair, bob cut, glasses, cap, round eyes, open mouth, excited, green coat, holding a notebook
portraits.memo: ボーイッシュで自分をボクと呼ぶおたく。早口で話している

portraits.name: グレイオル
portraits.tags: 1boy, emperor, 42 years old, black hair, slicked back hair, sharp eyes, expressionless, scars, very tall, muscular, black military uniform, white fur cape, sword at hip
portraits.memo: ノルディアの皇帝。寡黙で冷徹な現実主義者。カリスマ

portraits.name: ダリオ
portraits.tags: 1boy, old man, 59 years old, white hair, short hair, white beard, steel mask covering half of face, artificial eye, wrinkles, frown, huge, white plate armor, greatsword
portraits.memo: 帝国四騎士《氷壁の父》。巨漢の老騎士。不動・実直

portraits.name: エルナ
portraits.tags: 1girl, woman, 38 years old, red hair, short hair, military cap, expressionless, narrow eyes, black military coat, crest
portraits.memo: 帝国四騎士。命令をタスクとして処理する無表情。片足は義足（胸から上には出ない）

portraits.name: ヴァルグ
portraits.tags: 1boy, wolf boy, wolf ears, wolf tail, man, 33 years old, grey hair, wild hair, golden eyes, sharp eyes, fierce grin, fangs, scar, stubble, muscular, dark leather armor, sword
portraits.memo: 帝国四騎士。狼の獣人、元野盗の首領。荒々しいが頭が切れる

portraits.name: マルヴィナ
portraits.tags: 1girl, woman, blonde hair, long hair, black cloth mask covering lower face, glowing left eye, cyan eye, calm, black cloak, staff, bandages
portraits.memo: 帝国四騎士の女軍師。顔の下半分を布で覆い、左目が光る。年は分からない

portraits.name: カティア
portraits.tags: 1girl, princess, 19 years old, blonde hair, ponytail, blue eyes, determined, serious expression, white plate armor, crest, sword
portraits.memo: 皇帝の一人娘。正義感が強く真っすぐな努力家

portraits.name: アリシア
portraits.tags: 1girl, elf, high elf, long pointy ears, blonde hair, medium hair, hair between eyes, blue eyes, sharp eyes, piercing gaze, haughty, circlet, white noble dress, gem
portraits.memo: エルメシアの最高議長。ハイエルフ（見た目は二十代前半、三百歳超）。女王のような圧

portraits.name: 帝国の宰相
portraits.tags: 1boy, old man, 64 years old, grey hair, slicked back hair, narrow eyes, wrinkles, eye bags, expressionless, black formal clothes, chain of office
portraits.memo: 帝都の王城の玉座の脇。北の陣にいることの多い皇帝に代わって謁見を仕切る宰相。表情を出さない

portraits.name: 茹で騎士ガストン
portraits.tags: 1boy, knight, 34 years old, black hair, flushed face, red face, sweat, stubble, worried eyebrows, open mouth, plate armor, no helmet
portraits.memo: テルグリスの大鍋で茹でられかけた騎士。真っ赤で情けない顔

portraits.name: 脱走兵ヨアヒム
portraits.tags: 1boy, soldier, 35 years old, dark brown hair, stubble, eye bags, tired, worried eyebrows, imperial military uniform, snow on shoulders
portraits.memo: 凍えた帝国の脱走兵。もう人を殺したくない

portraits.name: 微笑の使徒カルマトス
portraits.tags: 1boy, young man, beautiful, androgynous face, silver hair, long hair, red eyes, glowing eyes, gentle smile, luxurious robe, gold embroidery, holding a parasol, puppet strings on fingers
portraits.memo: 人の姿の使徒（使徒リスト 28）。銀髪の美青年。豪奢な衣で、いつも微笑んでいる。人の苦しむ顔を愛でる

portraits.name: 砂塵の使徒ドレイゼ
portraits.tags: 1boy, man, 45 years old, sandy hair, short hair, narrow eyes, smirk, silver monocle, gaunt, money changer, sand-colored vest, sand spilling from sleeves, hourglass
portraits.memo: ブランデールの両替商（使徒リスト 64）。砂の体。袖から砂がこぼれる。嘘はつかないが全部は言わない

portraits.name: 取り立て屋ボルグ
portraits.tags: 1boy, man, 40 years old, huge man, messy hair, scar, stubble, grin, missing fingers, ragged clothes, debt collector
portraits.memo: ドレイゼの眷属。熊のような大男

portraits.name: 生き聖女ユヴァリエ
portraits.tags: 1girl, saint, 26 years old, blonde hair, long hair, large glowing butterfly wings, merciful smile, half-closed eyes, white and gold robe, sun emblem, staff
portraits.memo: 聖都の「生き聖女」（正体は蝶翅の使徒、使徒リスト 40）。蝶の羽を後光だと思われている。慈悲深そうな微笑み

portraits.name: 香煙の使徒ベリエラ
portraits.tags: 1girl, woman, 28 years old, long black hair, face half hidden by incense smoke, sheer veil, narrow eyes, calm smile, layered purple robe, hanging censer on a chain, smoke
portraits.memo: 朧島の、香の煙をまとった女（使徒リスト 18）。煙で顔ははっきり見えない。争いを嫌い、祭りと賽遊びが好き

portraits.name: 香炉番のシオン
portraits.tags: 1girl, 15 years old, long hair, mischievous smile, purple robe, small censer on a chain, dice cup, smoke
portraits.memo: ベリエラの眷属。賭場の壺振りの少女。いかさまが上手（id はもとの名のまま）

portraits.name: 苔衣の使徒セグリトス
portraits.tags: 1boy, old man, tall, gardener, bark-like skin, moss and ivy on clothes, mushrooms, spores, wide-brimmed hat, flowers on hat, glowing eyes, polite smile
portraits.memo: 毒沼の庭師（使徒リスト 7。本体は樹皮に覆われたのろい獣）。穏やかで丁寧、悪意がない

portraits.name: 疫医ベルナ
portraits.tags: 1girl, plague doctor, beak mask, black hooded coat, gloves, medicine bottles
portraits.memo: セグリトスの眷属の医者。嘴の仮面で顔は見せない。声は若い女

portraits.name: 剣翼の使徒ヴァルグレア
portraits.tags: 1boy, man, 40 years old, huge man, one black bird wing made of blades, blonde hair, glowing eyes, frown, crossed arms, black coat
portraits.memo: 刃を撃ち出す黒い鳥の使徒（使徒リスト 62）の人の姿。片翼の大男。転んだのを無かったことにする

portraits.name: 百面の使徒ディエラン（北の賢人）
portraits.tags: 1boy, old man, 72 years old, white hair, slicked back hair, monocle, mustache, mask-like face, expressionless, noble military coat, holding a chess piece, many masks hanging at belt
portraits.memo: 仮面をいくつも持つ使徒（使徒リスト 23）。今は宮廷の老将の面で、宰相の客分の軍師。駒に話しかける

portraits.name: 逆夢の使徒ベルファス
portraits.tags: toddler, androgynous, 3 years old, silver hair, messy hair, eyes closed, sleeping, floating upside down, pajamas, holding a pillow
portraits.memo: 眠り続ける幼子の姿の使徒（使徒リスト 2）。いつも目を閉じて眠っている。逆さの夢に出る。子どもらしく

portraits.name: 灰色の外套の旅人
portraits.tags: 1boy, man, ageless, brown hair, short hair, half-closed eyes, gentle smile, stubble, old grey cloak, traveler
portraits.memo: 年の分からない旅人。何でも珍しそうに喜ぶ

portraits.name: 東へ出る船の船長
portraits.tags: 1boy, old man, 52 years old, eyepatch, beard, sea captain, captain hat, navy coat
portraits.memo: 東の果てへ出る片目の船長

portraits.name: 宿の主人ハンス
portraits.tags: 1boy, middle-aged man, 58 years old, bald, kind smile, blush, apron, innkeeper
portraits.memo: 宿の主人。宿帳の年齢の欄で筆を止める

portraits.tags: 1girl, middle-aged woman, 50 years old, hair bun, smile, kerchief, apron, innkeeper
portraits.memo: 宿の女将。世話焼き
